verdict: DEAD (4-DOF, cx ~34.5; closes the spring-set cap-pole null-space class): 57.7 frozen exact Bench(110,360) (score 79.0; reach 0.7444, ib14 0.5476, contact 0.069, overhead 11/28, 1 flood island) vs its own plain cap 3R control 60.61 (searched to the gate, same kit) - 2.9 points for one more counted joint and three springs that must wind ~+-170 deg - and 39 points behind the lead (18.28, 3 joints). limiter: hub 2: fitted 121 mm from GH at the cap pole, in band 0.0 frozen (control 0.06); the 1-D null-space is spent on hub 0 / link 0 / hub 1 (0.98-1.0 in band); contact grows frozen (plain-gap search); springs must wind ~+-170 deg (dmax 120 collapses the cell to 102+ fast); J0 sweeps ~320 deg about the back seat
